Problems.title: Why Businesses Struggle to Scale Online
Problems.subtitle: Every brand hits the same wall — traffic plateaus, ads stop converting, and growth stalls. The issue isn't effort — it's structure.
Problems.helper: Tap any card to see how we approach it. Each problem has a clear, executable solution built into our workflow.

reach.title: Stagnant Reach
reach.problem: Outdated strategies fail to drive consistent traffic, and brand visibility slowly declines across every platform.
reach.solution: Data-driven growth strategies with continuous A/B testing, audience refinement, and platform-native distribution that keeps reach climbing.

engagement.title: Low Engagement
engagement.problem: Static posts and generic ads fail to capture attention in a feed that's already saturated with content.
engagement.solution: High-retention video ads and platform-specific creative built around hooks, pacing, and story — designed for the first three seconds.

branding.title: Weak Branding
branding.problem: Inconsistent visuals and scattered messaging make the business blend into the crowd — nothing feels ownable.
branding.solution: A unified brand system — logo, typography, palette, and messaging — applied consistently across every touchpoint.

funnels.title: Leaky Funnels
funnels.problem: Slow, unoptimized websites turn warm leads away before they ever reach checkout or contact.
funnels.solution: Fast, mobile-first pages with clear paths, sharp CTAs, and analytics wired in so every drop-off point is visible and fixable.

services.question: What services do you offer?
services.answer: We handle the full digital stack — Digital Marketing, Video Production, Branding & Design, and Web Development. Everything is delivered in-house by a single team, so your strategy, voice, and execution stay consistent across every channel.

global.question: Do you work with clients outside Bahrain?
global.answer: Yes. We're based in the Kingdom of Bahrain with a global client base. We deliver across regions and time zones without losing local nuance — whether your audience is regional or international.

bilingual.question: Do you deliver content in both Arabic and English?
bilingual.answer: Absolutely. Arabic and English are both handled natively by our team — no translation layer, no mixed messaging. Every asset is written, designed, and reviewed in the language it's meant for.

pricing.question: How does pricing and payment work?
pricing.answer: Custom projects (web, app, branding) require a 50% non-refundable advance deposit, with the remaining 50% due prior to final launch or code transfer. Monthly marketing and managed ad retainers are billed 100% upfront and due 5 days before the start of each cycle.

revisions.question: How many revisions are included?
revisions.answer: Custom development and graphic design projects include up to 3 standard revision rounds within the agreed initial scope. Any major structural changes or feature additions outside the original proposal are billed at standard hourly rates.

start.question: How do we get started on a project?
start.answer: It starts with a discovery call to understand your goals, audience, and timeline. From there, we send a tailored proposal with scope, deliverables, and timeline. Once approved and the deposit is settled, we kick off within the week.

AboutHero.subtitle: A bilingual creative publicity agency based in the Kingdom of Bahrain — helping modern brands tell sharper stories.

paragraphs.p1: BUZZLY Publicity is a bilingual creative agency based in the Kingdom of Bahrain.
paragraphs.p2: We help brands grow through thoughtful communication, sharp strategy, and creative execution.
paragraphs.p3: We work with brands across F&B, fashion, beauty, tech, and more — building campaigns in both Arabic and English.

story.p1: BUZZLY Publicity began with a simple belief: brands don't need more noise — they need clearer stories. In a market saturated with content, the brands that stand out are the ones that know exactly who they're speaking to, and why.
story.p2: We noticed that many businesses had great products and real ambition, but struggled to communicate them in a way that actually reached people. So we built a bilingual agency that combines strategy, creativity, and honest communication under one roof.
story.p3: Today, we work with brands across Bahrain and beyond — helping them sharpen their identity, build meaningful campaigns, and grow with intention rather than volume.

ContactFAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about working with BUZZLY. Can't find your answer? Reach out via the form.

q1.question: What is BUZZLY Publicity?
q1.answer: BUZZLY Publicity is a bilingual creative publicity agency based in the Kingdom of Bahrain. We help brands grow through PR, social media, branding, content, influencer marketing, and digital advertising.

q2.question: Where are you located?
q2.answer: Our office is in Muharraq, Kingdom of Bahrain. We work with clients locally and internationally.

q3.question: Do you work with international clients?
q3.answer: Yes. We work with clients across the GCC and internationally. All communication and deliverables can be handled remotely.

q4.question: What languages do you work in?
q4.answer: We work natively in both Arabic and English. Every deliverable is available in both languages if required.

q5.question: How do I contact you?
q5.answer: You can reach us via WhatsApp, email, or the inquiry form on this page. We respond within 24 hours.

q1.question: What services do you offer?
q1.answer: We offer six core services: Public Relations & Publicity, Social Media Marketing, Branding & Creative Strategy, Content Creation, Influencer Marketing, and Digital Advertising.

q2.question: Do you handle everything in-house?
q2.answer: Yes. Strategy, creative, and execution are all handled by our in-house team to ensure consistency across every channel.

q3.question: What is your process?
q3.answer: We follow a 5-step process: Understand, Strategize, Create, Execute, and Evaluate. This ensures every project is clear, measurable, and on schedule.

q4.question: How long does a project take?
q4.answer: Timelines depend on scope. A branding project typically takes 4-6 weeks, while a full campaign can range from 2-3 months. We provide a clear timeline before starting.

q5.question: Can you work with our existing brand guidelines?
q5.answer: Absolutely. We can work within your existing brand system or help you evolve it depending on your goals.

q1.question: How much do your services cost?
q1.answer: Pricing depends on the scope of the project. We provide custom quotes after understanding your needs. Contact us for a tailored proposal.

q2.question: Do you require a deposit?
q2.answer: Yes. For most projects, we require a 50% non-refundable deposit to secure your slot. The remaining 50% is due before final delivery.

q3.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q3.answer: We accept bank transfers and major payment gateways. Invoices are issued in BHD, USD, or EUR.

q4.question: Are there any hidden fees?
q4.answer: Never. Every cost is clearly outlined in the proposal before we begin. There are no surprise charges.

q5.question: Do you offer monthly retainers?
q5.answer: Yes. For social media, PR, and advertising, we offer monthly retainers that cover ongoing strategy, execution, and reporting.

q1.question: How do we get started?
q1.answer: Fill out the inquiry form on this page or message us on WhatsApp. We'll schedule a discovery call to discuss your goals.

q2.question: Do you require a contract?
q2.answer: Yes. We use clear, fair contracts that protect both parties. Everything is agreed upon before work begins.

q3.question: Who owns the final work?
q3.answer: You do. Upon final payment, 100% ownership of all deliverables and source files transfers to you.

q4.question: How many revisions are included?
q4.answer: Standard projects include up to 3 revision rounds. Any major changes outside the agreed scope are billed at our hourly rate.

q5.question: Can I cancel a project?
q5.answer: Yes, with 7 business days written notice. You will only be billed for the work completed up to that point.

meta.title: Privacy Policy — BUZZLY Publicity
meta.description: How BUZZLY Publicity collects, uses, and protects your data.

overview.title: Overview
overview.content: BUZZLY PUBLICITY & ADVERTISING W.L.L ("BUZZLY", "we", "us", or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website or interact with our services.

dataCollect.title: Data We Collect
dataCollect.content: We only collect information that you voluntarily provide through our contact form. This includes your email address. We do not use tracking pixels, cookies for advertising, or third-party analytics that identify individual users.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.content: The information we collect is used solely to: (a) respond to your inquiries; (b) send you a one-time thank-you email confirming receipt of your message; and (c) maintain internal records of incoming inquiries. We do not sell, rent, or share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: To operate efficiently, we use the following trusted services: Supabase (secure database for storing inquiries) and Gmail SMTP (for sending transactional emails). Both services are GDPR-compliant and handle your data securely.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: We retain your email address only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy. You may request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: You have the right to: (a) access the personal data we hold about you; (b) request correction or deletion of your data; (c) withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, please contact us at buzzlypublicityandadvertising@gmail.com.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at buzzlypublicityandadvertising@gmail.com or via our Contact Page.

meta.title: Terms of Service — BUZZLY Publicity
meta.description: The terms and conditions governing all services provided by BUZZLY Publicity.

overview.title: 1. Overview & Service Framework
overview.content: These Master Terms of Service govern all project engagements, digital services, and online subscriptions provided by BUZZLY PUBLICITY & ADVERTISING W.L.L. By placing an order or engaging our services, the Client agrees to be legally bound by these terms.

payment.title: 2. Financial Terms & Payments
payment.content: Custom Projects: 50% advance non-refundable deposit required to secure your slot. The remaining 50% is due prior to final launch, code transfer, or domain pointing. Monthly Retainers: 100% upfront retainer, due 5 days prior to the start of each billing cycle. Ad Spend Budgets are paid directly by the Client to the respective platforms.

responsibilities.title: 3. Client Responsibilities
responsibilities.content: The Client must supply all required text, high-resolution logos, images, and credentials within 7 working days of project kickoff. Delays exceeding 10 business days without communication will result in a project queue pause. The Client guarantees that all provided assets are legally licensed.

revisions.title: 4. Revisions & Scope
revisions.content: Custom development and design projects include up to 3 standard revision rounds within the agreed initial scope. Any major structural revisions or requested feature additions outside the original proposal will be billed at our standard hourly rate.

advertising.title: 5. Paid Advertising Disclaimer
advertising.content: BUZZLY employs data-driven strategies to optimize campaigns. However, market conversion rates depend on product demand, pricing, and competitor activity. We guarantee execution excellence but do not guarantee fixed sales volumes or exact revenue metrics.

ip.title: 6. Intellectual Property
ip.content: Final deliverables and source code are transferred 100% to the Client upon full payment completion. BUZZLY retains ownership of proprietary agency tools and workflows. We reserve the right to display completed work in our portfolio unless an NDA is executed.

liability.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: BUZZLY shall not be held liable for third-party platform downtimes (e.g., Meta ad suspensions, web host outages). Either party may terminate a project with 7 business days written notice. The client will be invoiced for all completed work hours up to that date.

law.title: 8. Governing Law
law.content: These terms and conditions are governed by the commercial laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Bahrain. Any legal disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Courts of the Kingdom of Bahrain.
